episodes.synopsis: A young man begins a new life at Amagami shrine, and meets the three sisters who live there.
episodes.title: The Miracle Begins

episodes.synopsis: The sisters plot to drive Uryu away by making him do all the chores.
episodes.title: String Cranes at Midday

episodes.synopsis: Uryu has marriage meetings with all three of the sisters.
episodes.title: A Tryst with the Gods

episodes.synopsis: The sisters are forced to get 5,000 people to come to their upcoming festival, or they'll have to sell the shrine.
episodes.title: The Amagami Shrine Festival ~Connections~

episodes.synopsis: Trouble strikes on the day of the festival! Will enough people come to save the shrine?
episodes.title: The Amagami Shrine Festival ~Blossoming~

episodes.synopsis: Uryu reflects on what happened after the shrine festival, and Asahi offers to help find the answer to his question.
episodes.title: From Dawn till Dusk

episodes.synopsis: The sisters seek help from the priestess who trained them, but are met with an unexpected demand.
episodes.title: Dream and Moon and Dream ~New Moon~

episodes.synopsis: Yae wonders about her future, while Asahi thinks of moving away.
episodes.title: Dream and Moon and Dream ~Half Moon~

episodes.synopsis: The girls give Yomiko the answer, and Uryu promises to support their dreams.
episodes.title: Dream and Moon and Dream ~Full Moon~

episodes.synopsis: With spring break over, Uryu unexpectedly finds himself at the same school as Yuna.
episodes.title: Changing Clothes, Changing Hearts

episodes.synopsis: As the sisters and Uryu go out for a late-night trip, Uryu wonders about something strange he found...
episodes.title: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Prelude~

episodes.synopsis: The sisters, Makoto, and Uryu arrive at Inari Shrine, where Uryu has a strange experience.
episodes.title: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Connections~

episodes.synopsis: Uryu remembers how he first met Yae, and Yae makes a big decision.
episodes.title: The Real Reason for Staying Up Late ~Love~

episodes.synopsis: Asahi is training for a marathon, but an unexpected rainstorm moves it to the day of a big festival at the shrine.
episodes.title: The Scales That Hold Wishes ~Loop~

episodes.synopsis: After failing to escape from the time loop, Uryu is forced to consider what it is that Asahi really wants.
episodes.title: The Scales That Hold Wishes ~Going Back~

episodes.synopsis: Asahi realizes what it is she really wants as the loop comes to an end.
episodes.title: The Scales That Hold Wishes ~Going Forward~

episodes.synopsis: When Uryu's grades start to slip, the sisters make a decision.
episodes.title: The Send-Off Fires and the Vow With the Gods

episodes.synopsis: Yuna and Uryu are forced to deal with a shocking occurrence.
episodes.title: Nadeshiko Hide-and-Seek ~Switch~

episodes.synopsis: While Yuna and Uryu get used to their new life, Yuna's best friend notices something is wrong.
episodes.title: Nadeshiko Hide-and-Seek ~Worry~

episodes.synopsis: As the culture festival comes to a close, Yuna reflects on what really drives her.
episodes.title: Nadeshiko Hide-and-Seek ~Attraction~

episodes.synopsis: Shirahi is heartbroken when she sees the growing relationship between Uryu and the sisters.
episodes.title: Shirahi's Mirage ~Divergence~

episodes.synopsis: Uryu finds himself trapped in another world where he lives with Shirahi.
episodes.title: Shirahi's Mirage ~Feelings~

episodes.synopsis: Uryu discovers the truth about what led him to this world.
episodes.title: Shirahi's Mirage ~Ties~

episodes.synopsis: Uryu and Shirahi make a choice about their future.
episodes.title: Tying the Knot with an Amagami Sister
